mediahud.configuration.title: Media HUD
mediahud.configuration.corner.tooltip: AUTO: top right if Xaero's Minimap is installed, otherwise top left
mediahud.configuration.size.tooltip: 1 = small, 2 = medium, 3 = large (in addition to the GUI scale)
mediahud.configuration.pauseTimeout.tool: Hide the display after the media has been paused for this many seconds. 0 = never, max. 300
mediahud.configuration.offsetX.tooltip: Distance to the screen edge (GUI pixels)
mediahud.configuration.offsetY.tooltip: Distance to the screen edge (GUI pixels). Increase to move below a minimap.
mediahud.configuration.sources.tooltip: Windows app ids of the programs that are shown. Empty = all programs. Easier: use the whitelist buttons on the Media HUD config page.
mediahud.screen.title: Media HUD
mediahud.screen.hint.all: Nothing whitelisted: every program is shown.
mediahud.screen.empty: No program is reporting media right now.
